issues.title: Purchase event fires on ~10% of orders
issues.detail: The purchase event is gated on a payment-verified timestamp that usually lands after the confirmation page renders. ~140 orders since Friday produced 11 pixel purchases. Every platform's reported conversions and every bid decision run on a 10% sample.
issues.fix: Fire the purchase event on order creation, unconditionally, every payment path — server-side if a path skips the confirmation page. Ticket sent to Lovable; acceptance is one full day where pixel purchases ≈ admin orders.

issues.title: OpenAI pixel undercounts the funnel
issues.detail: order_created has gone 0 → 3 since the schema fix, so purchases now land. But 220 checkout_started against 634 real orders means the pixel sees roughly a third of checkouts and almost no purchases.
issues.fix: Find why most orders never fire the pixel — installed mid-week, or a checkout path that skips it.
issues.status: Open — schema fixed, coverage is not

issues.title: Zero identifier coverage on OpenAI events
issues.detail: Email coverage 0.0% and External ID coverage 0.0% across all 188 events. Without either identifier OpenAI cannot tie an event back to a user, so conversions land in the unattributed bucket and the campaign optimizes on a weaker signal than it should.
issues.fix: Send a hashed email and a stable external ID on both events. The order flow already captures email at checkout, and create-order already writes a customer record — so the value exists, it just is not being passed to the pixel.
issues.status: Open — worth fixing before spend scales

issues.title: One dedupe key shared across Meta and TikTok
issues.detail: Both server functions dedupe on meta_event_id. It works today, but couples two platforms to one identifier — a change made for one silently affects the other.
issues.fix: Leave as-is unless a change is needed. If either platform's dedupe is ever edited, test both.

issues.title: Ad account sits outside the business portfolio
issues.detail: Ad account 880814205101777 is attached to the Sko Compounds portfolio as an outside asset; the portfolio itself owns zero ad accounts. Originally created as a personal ad account.
issues.fix: Business Settings → Accounts → Ad accounts → Claim → 880814205101777. Then audit who retains access and remove anyone who has left.
issues.status: Open — no longer blocks the pixel, still an access risk

issues.title: Meta payment errors throttle delivery
issues.detail: Both campaigns show Payment error · low budget used. The company card caps unsupervised spend, so charges fail until pushed manually; every stall stops delivery and resets pacing.
issues.fix: Onboard the replacement card. Until then, expect Meta results to under-read the creative.
